name: Kodak Portra 800
notes: Fuji X Weekly, Kodak Portra 800 v3. Color Chrome FX Blue is Off on X-Trans V bodies, Weak on X-Trans IV - set to Weak here as the safer default. Source: fujixweekly.com/2024/02/14/kodak-portra-800-v3-fujifilm-x-t5-x-trans-v-x-e4-x-trans-iv-film-simulation-recipe/

name: Kodak Ektar 100
notes: Fuji X Weekly, Fujifilm X100V recipe. Original notes that Ektar's punchy palette is hard to reproduce faithfully - Classic Chrome is used as the base because it has the right hue even though it's less vibrant than Velvia. Source: fujixweekly.com/2020/08/10/fujifilm-x100v-film-simulation-recipe-kodak-ektar-100/

name: Ektachrome 320T
notes: Fuji X Weekly, Fujifilm X-E4 recipe. Emulates a tungsten-balanced slide film from 1992, meant for night/indoor artificial light. Source: fujixweekly.com/2021/04/26/fujifilm-x-e4-film-simulation-recipe-ektachrome-320t/

name: Fujicolor Negative
notes: Fuji X Weekly, Fujifilm X100V (X-Trans IV) recipe. Good contrast, natural/muted colors, a film-like quality. Source: fujixweekly.com/2021/05/09/fujifilm-x100v-x-trans-iv-film-simulation-recipe-fujicolor-negative/
